About the Scholarship

The Sir Paul Callaghan scholarship supports doctoral research in chemistry and physics at Massey's Manawatū campus. The award has citizenship or residency restrictions, and its next application period opens in April 2027. Massey University invites applications for a PhD position in this area: Sir Paul Callaghan Doctoral Scholarship in Chemistry and Physics 2027. The work sits within Chemistry, Physics. Location: Various, New Zealand. According to the listing, funding is partial; financial support is listed as NZD 105,000 total award. Interested candidates should note the deadline: 1 June 2027.

Research Areas

  • Chemistry
  • Physics
  • Doctoral research

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.massey.ac.nz/study/scholarships-and-awards/sir-paul-callaghan-doctoral-scholarship-in-chemistry-and-physics/

Source: massey.ac.nz - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 June 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Review the eligibility criteria carefully; applications outside the stated scope are usually rejected at the first screening stage.

How to Apply

  1. Review the official programme page and check the opening date for the next call.
  2. Use the new call to select a project or research area and identify the documents required for that application route.
  3. Complete the submission when the application window opens, using the new deadline rather than an earlier recruitment cycle.

Massey offers doctoral research in science, food technology and other disciplines. Its scholarship portfolio includes alumni awards and subject-specific funding, with eligibility and application dates set out for each award.
